description: An open coloring book lies on the table with a brightly colored fish on the right page, and a box of crayons sits above the book. The left hand stays resting near the left side of the book while the right hand lifts a light-blue crayon from the table, moves up toward the crayon box, dips it into the box briefly, then pulls back and returns toward the book area, releasing the crayon and leaving the right hand empty.
